message.content:
Here’s a quick‑and‑easy **Spaghetti Bolognese** recipe you’ll love—classic Italian flavor, hearty enough for a family dinner or leftovers for lunch tomorrow!

---

### Ingredients  

| Quantity | Item |
|----------|------|
| 400 g (14 oz) | Dry spaghetti (or your favorite pasta shape) |
| 2 tbsp | Olive oil |
| 1 onion | Finely diced |
| 2 cloves garlic | Minced |
| 250 g (9 oz) | Ground beef (80/20 lean/fat ratio works best) |
| 100 ml (⅓ cup) | Red wine (optional – adds depth) |
| 800 g canned tomatoes | Crushed or whole peeled, crushed manually |
| 2 tsp dried oregano | Or fresh chopped herbs |
| 1 tsp dried basil | |
| Salt & pepper | To taste |
| Pinch of sugar | Optional, balances acidity |
| Grated Parmesan cheese | For serving |
| Fresh parsley or basil leaves | Chopped, optional garnish |

> *Tip:* If you prefer a vegetarian version, swap ground beef for lentils or finely minced mushrooms.

---

### Instructions  

#### 1️⃣ Prep the Sauce  
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.  
2. Add onions and sauté until translucent (~5 min).  
3. Stir in garlic and cook another minute until fragrant.  
4. Increase heat to high, add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned all around (~8–10 min). Drain excess fat if needed.  
5. Pour in red wine (if using), let reduce ~2 minutes.  
6. Add canned tomatoes, oregano, basil, salt, pepper, and pinch of sugar. Bring to a gentle simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover partially, and let thicken while stirring occasionally — aim for at least 30 min. Longer cooking gives richer flavors (up to an hour).

#### 2️⃣ Boil Pasta  
While sauce simmers, bring a pot of salted water to boil.  
Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente (usually 8–11 min). Reserve ½ cup of pasta water before draining.

#### 3️⃣ Combine & Finish  
1. Toss drained spaghetti into the sauce, adding reserved pasta water as needed to loosen consistency. Mix well so each strand coats nicely.  
2. Taste and adjust seasoning.  
3. Serve hot topped with grated Parmesan and fresh herbs.

---

### Serving Ideas  

* Pair with a crisp green salad dressed simply with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.  
* Offer crusty bread or garlic knots on the side.  
* Leftovers reheat beautifully—just stir in a splash of milk or broth to keep sauce silky.

Enjoy this comforting plate of spaghetti! 🍝
